_comment: Per-region terrain config. Heightmap is a grayscale PNG; pixel 0 maps to height_range_min meters, pixel 255 to height_range_max. world_extent is the side length in meters (square region centered at world_origin). Subdivide controls mesh density (verts per side). Keep in sync with scripts/gen_terrain_heightmap.py defaults. selva_inner: wake-zone basin (Y=-3) surrounded by gentle berm + the colle / dilettoso monte rising to Y=+35 in the -Z direction (~35m total relief above wake-zone floor, the canonical mecca of the Wood).

player_spawn._comment: Player spawn position in world coordinates. X/Z only - Y is sampled from the heightmap at runtime so the player always stands on the ground regardless of heightmap regeneration. The wake-zone (X=0, Z=0) is the canonical Dante 'lost center' spawn: deep wood floor, no clear orientation, the colle visible to the south (-Z).
